_readme: The brief is explicit: 'Nevymyslaj naklady.' No hourly rate, fuel burn or crew cost is
entered here unless it comes from a citable source. As of the initial commit we have not
yet obtained sourced operating figures for the Slovak government fleet, so the models
below carry structure and sources-to-obtain, not numbers.
Consequence by design: with ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_COST_MODELS=false (the default) the cost
engine returns 'data unavailable' for these aircraft rather than a plausible-looking
invented figure. That is the correct behaviour until the inputs are sourced.
Candidate primary sources to obtain (see COST_MODEL.md):
- MV SR budget chapter and annual reports (fixed cost, crew, maintenance contracts)
- Public procurement contracts for fuel, maintenance and handling (crz.gov.sk)
- Freedom-of-information requests under zakon c. 211/2000 Z. z. for per-hour operating cost
- Airport published charges for LZIB and destination airports (handling, landing fees)
